abstract_zh: 在视觉注意力的长期研究中，已经提出了各种计算模型。然而，大多数这些作品都没有考虑音频。在实践中，视觉信号通常与音频一起出现。因此，研究音频对视觉注意力的影响是很自然的。在本文中，我们关注视频观看过程中音频何时会影响视觉注意力的问题。我们在视听 (AV) 和视觉 (V) 条件下对一组 60 个视频进行了眼动追踪实验。基于眼动数据，我们发现音频对视觉注意力的影响取决于视觉和音频信号之间的一致性。如果显着物体来自...
abstract_en: In the long term research of visual attention, various computational models have been proposed. However, most of those works do not take audio into consideration. In practice, visual signals often come along with audio. Therefore, it is natural to investigate the influence of audio on visual attention. In this paper, we focus on the problem of when will audio influence visual attention during video watching. We perform eye-tracking experiments on a set of 60 videos in audio-visual (AV) and visual (V) conditions. Based on the eye movement data, we find that the influence of audio on visual attention depends on the consistency between the visual and audio signals. If the salient objects from the visual perspective are not consistent with the salient objects from the audio perspective, audio will influence visual attention. Otherwise, audio has little influence on visual attention.

title_zh: 通过空间心理视觉调制同步双字幕展览
title_en: Simultaneous dual-subtitles exhibition via Spatial Psychovisual Modulation
authors: Chunjia Hu；Guangtao Zhai；Zhongpai Gao；Xiongkuo Min
primary_category: 情感理解与多模态推理
abstract_zh: 院内电影放映双语注释是一种有助于不同国家、不同文化背景的观众理解电影的有用技术。目前，最流行的解决方案是在电影上直接叠加两种不同语言的字幕，例如：英文+中文，现在在中国的电影院里经常可以看到。这种简单解决方案的一个明显缺点是字幕区域经常遮挡电影内容，甚至让观众感到厌烦。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于空间心理视觉调制（SPVM）的新解决方案来解决双语字幕问题。 SPVM 是一种新...
abstract_en: Dual-language annotation for in-theatre movie exhibition is a useful technique to facilitate the understanding of the movie for audiences from different nations and with different cultural backgrounds. Currently, the most popular solution is the direct superimposition of subtitles in a pair of different languages over the movie, e.g. English + Chinese which can often be seen in cinema in China today. An obvious drawback of this straightforward solution is that the subtitle area often occludes the movie contents and even becomes annoying for the audience. In this paper, we propose a new Spatial Psychovisual Modulation (SPVM) based solution to the dual-language subtitling problem. SPVM is a new paradigm of information display exploiting the mismatch between high resolution of the modern optoelectronic displays and limited spatial resolution of the human visual system (HVS). In this work, we design a simultaneous dual-subtitle exhibition system using 2 synchronized projectors with linear polarization filters and polarization glasses. Most audiences can enjoy the movie as usual with a default subtitle language, say English, while others have the option of only seeing subtitle in the other language, e.g. Chinese using the polarization glasses. We have implemented the system and experimental results will be demonstrated to justify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed dual-subtitle exhibition system.

title_zh: 图像质量评估数据库的视觉注意数据
title_en: Visual attention data for image quality assessment databases
venue: IEEE International Symposium on Circuits and Systems proceedings
authors: Xiongkuo Min；Guangtao Zhai；Zhongpai Gao；Ke Gu
primary_category: 情感数据集、基准与评测
topics: 情感智能评测；图像/视频诱发情感理解；多模态大模型评测
abstract_zh: 图像通常包含特别吸引人们注意的区域，视觉注意力是人类视觉系统（HVS）的重要特征。视觉注意力已被证明可以有效提高现有图像质量评估（IQA）指标的性能。然而，随着IQA研究的快速进展，开放IQA数据库的蓬勃发展需要相关的全面、准确的视觉注意力数据集。尽管现有大量的计算注意力/显着性模型，但人类注意力最准确的衡量仍然是基于人类的。在这项研究中，我们首先对来自七个宽屏的所有原始图像进行了广泛的眼动追踪实验。
abstract_en: Images usually contain areas that particularly attract people's attention and visual attention is an important feature of human visual system (HVS). Visual attention had been shown to be effective in improving performance of existing image quality assessment (IQA) metrics. However, with the quick advancement of IQA research, the booming of open IQA databases calls for associated comprehensive and accurate visual attention dataset. Despite of the large number of existing computational attention/saliency models, the most accurate measure of human attention is still human based. In this research, we first conduct extensive eye tracking experiments for all the pristine images from the seven widely used IQA databases (LIVE, TID2008, CSIQ, Toyama, LIVE Multiply Distortion, IVC and A57 databases). Then we propose a gaze-duration adaptive weighting approach to generate saliency maps from the eye tracking data. When applied on the IQA databases, experimental results suggest that accuracy of benchmark quality metrics, e.g. PSNR and SSIM can be systematically improved, outperforming existing saliency datasets. Both the eye tracking data and the saliency maps in this research will be made publicly available at gvsp.sjtu.edu.cn.

title_zh: 压缩伪影对视觉注意力的影响
title_en: Influence of compression artifacts on visual attention
venue: IEEE International Conference on Multimedia and Expo (ICME)
authors: Xiongkuo Min；Guangtao Zhai；Zhongpai Gao；Chunjia Hu
primary_category: 情感数据集、基准与评测
topics: 情感智能评测；图像/视频诱发情感理解；多模态大模型评测
abstract_zh: 视觉注意力是人类视觉系统（HVS）的重要功能。在视觉注意力的长期研究中，人们提出了各种计算模型并取得了令人鼓舞的结果。然而，大多数这些工作都是在具有理想视觉质量的图像上进行的。在实践中，大多数视觉通信系统的输出包含不同级别的伪影，例如噪声、模糊、块状等。因此，研究伪像对视觉注意力的影响是很有趣的。在本文中，我们探讨了广泛遇到的 JPEG 压缩伪像如何影响视觉注意力的问题。我们在不同级别的图像上设计了眼动追踪实验......
abstract_en: Visual attention is an important function of the human visual system (HVS). In the long term research of visual attention, various computational models have been proposed with encouraging results. However, most of those work were conducted on images with ideal visual quality. In practice, outputs of most visual communication systems contain different levels of artifacts, e.g. noise, blurring, blockiness and etc. Therefore, it is interesting to investigate the impacts of artifacts on visual attention. In this paper, we question into the problem of how the widely encountered JPEG compression artifacts affect visual attention. We designed eye-tracking experiments on images with different levels of compression and viewing time and quantitatively compared the recorded eye movement data. We found that compression level does have impacts on visual attention, and yet this influence can be negligible for low levels of compression. For high levels of compression, the visual artifacts alter visual attention in a systematic way. Dependence of the influence on viewing duration was also analyzed and it was observed that too short or too long viewing time reduces the impact of compression artifacts on visual attention.

title_zh: 演示：基于 DLP 的防盗版显示系统
title_en: Demo: DLP based anti-piracy display system
authors: Zhongpai Gao；Guangtao Zhai；Xiaolin Wu；Xiongkuo Min；Chunjia Hu
primary_category: 情感理解与多模态推理
abstract_zh: 摄像机盗版对电影业影响很大。尽管有很多防止影院录制的方法，但没有一种公认的技术既能满足打击摄像机盗版的需要，又不会对观众造成影响。为了实现反盗版，我们使用了一种新的信息显示技术范式，称为时间心理视觉调制（TPVM）。 TPVM 利用人眼和成像传感器的图像形成机制的差异。基于这种差异，我们在 DLP® LightCrafter 4500™ 平台上构建了一个具有高速图案显示功能的原型系统。该显示系统可作为反盗版系统的概念验证。
abstract_en: Camcorder piracy has great impact on the movie industry. Although there are many methods to prevent recording in theatre, no recognized technology satisfies the need of defeating camcorder piracy as well as having no effect on the audience. To realize anti-piracy, we uses a new paradigm of information display technology, called temporal psychovisual modulation (TPVM). TPVM exploits the difference in image formation mechanisms of human eyes and imaging sensors. Based on this difference, we build a prototype system on the platform of DLP® LightCrafter 4500™ which features high speed pattern display. The display system serves as a proof-of-concept of anti-piracy system.
